title: Industrial Age
description: Quests for the Industrial Age progression path.

quests.title: Novice Engineer
description: The first engineering stage. Thermal, Ender IO and Cyclic all keep their low tier locked until you hold it.

quests.title: Bedrock Dust
description: Ignite a bedrock to acquire Grains of Infinity

quests.title: Better Machines B
description: Capacitors are the dial on every Ender IO machine, speed against power draw. This is the bottom of that dial.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p {"text":"Your world has been blessed with new rare metals."}

quests.title: Infinite Water
description: Endless water with no hauling. Half the Thermal line and every Mekanism chain past this point runs on it.

quests.title: Turbo Boost
description: Dynamos take augments. Fuel handling is the first thing worth changing about one.

quests.title: Electrified Iron
description: Empowered crystals are the tier above ordinary ones. The Actually Additions Manual explains what the Empowerer wants from you.

quests.title: Advanced Wires
description: Acquire an XNet wire, it transfers fluid, energy and items and has minimum impact on performance.

quests.title: Fluid Factory
description: Machines are thirsty work. A pressurized tank is the buffer everything downstream drinks from.

quests.title: Skilled Engineer
description: The mid-game engineering stage. Yellorium and the rest of the Big Reactors ores stay inert without it, and the Solar Flux and Mekanism lines sit behind it.

quests.title: Dark Steel
description: Ender IO runs on this metal, from its machines to its armour. Dungeon chests occasionally save you the smelting.

quests.title: Ore Doubling
description: Ore doubling. From here every vein you break is worth twice what it was, which is the largest single jump in this chapter.

quests.title: Mystical Machine
description: Workhorse of the Thermal line, and the gate with it: finishing this opens Novice Engineer and the machinery tier behind it.

quests.title: Industrial Evolution III
description: Reinforced parts made your machines bigger. This one makes them cheaper: same work, less power, which is what lets a base outgrow its generator.

quests.title: Diamond But Better
description: Diamond, taken a step further. Same process as the other crystals, richer result.

quests.title: Better Machines A
description: The primitive smelter was a stopgap. The powered one is what the rest of Ender IO alloying is built on.

quests.title: Rage of the Villagers
description: Throttling: a dynamo that idles instead of burning fuel with nowhere to put the power.

quests.title: Dragon Slayer
description: Complete "Dragon Slayer" to continue.

quests.title: 2H2O==2H2↑+O2↑
description: Water split into hydrogen and oxygen. Mekanism's gas economy, and every ore tier above doubling, starts with those two.

quests.title: Crush 'em
description: Tripling. Each tier of this chain gets longer and hungrier; this is where it starts wanting gas.

quests.title: Pulverizer
description: Crushing clumps back down to dust. Pointless on its own, essential in sequence.

quests.title: Dust to Dust
description: Doubling, the Mekanism way, and the first of the machines that stack into quadrupled ore.

quests.title: Environmentalist I
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Environmentalist II
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Environmentalist III
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Environmentalist IV
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Environmentalist V
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Infused With Energy
description: A charging bench for anything that holds power. Tools, capacitors and flux gear stop being disposable.

quests.title: Best Machines B
description: Second notch on the capacitor dial. The SAG Mill stops being the thing everything waits for.

quests.title: Environmentalist VI
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Environmentalist VII
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Master Engineer
description: The last engineering stage. Ultimate circuits, atomic alloy and the top solar panels all wait on it.

quests.title: Environmentalist VIII
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Neutron Energy
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Wyvern Energy
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Redstone Furnace
description: Smelting that runs on power instead of fuel. The first machine most bases never switch off.

quests.title: Empowered Lapis
description: Lapis in empowered form. A component for the machines further up Actually Additions, not a decoration.

quests.title: Cooldown Cycle
description: Bigger output buffers. Machines stop stalling the moment nobody is there to empty them.

quests.title: Empowered Coal
description: Void crystals, empowered. Another colour of the set the later recipes keep asking for.

quests.title: Burn Them to Dust
description: Lets a machine work through more than one recipe without you standing over it.

quests.title: Cooking Oil is Oil
description: Machines that bank their experience instead of scattering it across the floor.

quests.title: Master of Oil
description: More power out of the same fuel. You will notice this one on every dynamo you own.

quests.title: Water Cooling
description: Fluids do not keep in buckets. A cell is the buffer your dynamos and machines feed from.

quests.title: Best Machines A
description: Soul-powered butchery, mobs processed by machine instead of by sword. The Ender IO guide covers what it will accept.

quests.title: Empowered Emerald
description: Emerald tier. Nothing new to learn, just one more crystal for the Empowerer to chew through.

quests.title: Infinite Energy
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Expanded Tanks
description: More internal tank, fewer trips. Fluid machines start running unattended.

quests.title: Empowered Redstone
description: The redstone half of the crystal set, and the one you will burn through fastest.

quests.title: Draconic Energy
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Chaotic Energy
description: Craft the required solar panel

quests.title: Heat Overload
description: Amplification for the potion side of Thermal: stronger effects out of the same brew.

quests.title: Ice and Fire
description: Raw speed, paid for in power. Eventually this goes into everything.

quests.title: Brain of the Network
description: One block routes items, fluid and power for a whole base and barely costs a tick. It is hungry for energy, and blind to anything a connector is not touching.

quests.title: Machine Frame
description: Nearly every Thermal machine is the same box with different guts: a frame, a coil, and the gears that decide what it does.
Stock up on both now and the rest of this branch is assembly.

quests.title: Stage recovery
description: Gamestages is a bit weird sometimes! If the stage from "Even More Upgrades" did not stick, claim this to get it back.
Safe to use more than once.

quests.title: Stage recovery
description: Gamestages is a bit weird sometimes! If the stage from "Mystical Machine" did not stick, claim this to get it back.
Safe to use more than once.

quests.title: Stage recovery
description: Gamestages is a bit weird sometimes! If the stage from "Quadruple Ores" did not stick, claim this to get it back.
Safe to use more than once.

quests.title: Stage recovery
description: Gamestages is a bit weird sometimes! If the stage from "Infinite Energy" did not stick, claim this to get it back.
Safe to use more than once.
